import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 210;
    static final int S = MAXN - 2;
    static final int T = MAXN - 1;
    static final int INF = 2000 * 1000 * 1000;
    static final int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] b = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] dist = new int[15][15];
    static boolean[][] used = new boolean[15][15];
    static MaxFlow maxFlow = new MaxFlow();

    static class MaxFlow {
        int[][] cap = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        int[][] flow = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        boolean[] used = new boolean[MAXN];

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            this.cap[from][to] += cap;
        }

        int getMaxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int totalFlow = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(used, false);
                Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
                q.add(s);
                used[s] = true;
                int[] parent = new int[MAXN];
                Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int v = q.poll();
                    for (int u = 0; u < MAXN; u++) {
                        if (!used[u] && cap[v][u] - flow[v][u] > 0) {
                            used[u] = true;
                            parent[u] = v;
                            q.add(u);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!used[t]) break;
                int add = INF;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                    int u = parent[v];
                    add = Math.min(add, cap[u][v] - flow[u][v]);
                }
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                    int u = parent[v];
                    flow[u][v] += add;
                    flow[v][u] -= add;
                }
                totalFlow += add;
            }
            return totalFlow;
        }
    }

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < n && 0 <= y && y < n && a[x][y] != 'Y' && a[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsDeath(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);
        }
        Queue<Integer> X = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> Y = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[x][y] = 0;
        X.add(x);
        Y.add(y);
        while (!X.isEmpty()) {
            int curx = X.poll();
            int cury = Y.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = curx + dx[k];
                int ty = cury + dy[k];
                if (ok(tx, ty) && dist[tx][ty] == INF) {
                    dist[tx][ty] = dist[curx][cury] + 1;
                    X.add(tx);
                    Y.add(ty);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void runBFS(int x, int y) {
        Queue<Integer> X = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> Y = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> lev = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(used[i], false);
        used[x][y] = true;
        X.add(x);
        Y.add(y);
        lev.add(0);
        while (!X.isEmpty()) {
            int curx = X.poll();
            int cury = Y.poll();
            int curlev = lev.poll();
            if (Character.isDigit(b[curx][cury]) && b[curx][cury] != '0') {
                maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, n * n + 1 + curx * n + cury, INF);
            }
            if (curlev >= t) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = curx + dx[k];
                int ty = cury + dy[k];
                if (ok(tx, ty) && !used[tx][ty]) {
                    if (dist[tx][ty] > curlev + 1) {
                        X.add(tx);
                        Y.add(ty);
                        lev.add(curlev + 1);
                    } else if (dist[tx][ty] > curlev && Character.isDigit(b[tx][ty]) && b[tx][ty] != '0') {
                        maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, n * n + 1 + tx * n + ty, INF);
                    }
                    used[tx][ty] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void build() {
        int posi = -1, posj = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && posi == -1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n && posi == -1; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    posi = i;
                    posj = j;
                }
            }
        }
        bfsDeath(posi, posj);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0') {
                    maxFlow.addEdge(S, i * n + j, a[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(b[i][j]) && b[i][j] != '0') {
                    maxFlow.addEdge(i * n + j + n * n + 1, T, b[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0') {
                    runBFS(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume rest of first line
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            a[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        sc.nextLine(); // consume blank line
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            b[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        build();
        System.out.println(maxFlow.getMaxFlow(S, T));
        sc.close();
    }
}
